pr_metadata.title: docs(release): document rolling back a release and switching the marketplace ref
pr_metadata.summary: Adds the rollback runbook to the release guide and documents the plugin marketplace's v2.1 ref, how to switch existing machines and how a rollback reaches them, so the fleet can follow and roll back the floating plugin tag.
pr_metadata.notes:
Agentic-review gate: pass after 5 rounds (rounds 4 and 5 ran by human ruling, beyond the default three). Round 5 had no blocking findings. vrg-validate is green at the final commit.

Approved scope additions (human ruling), done on this branch, to be closed by hand after merge:
- vergil-project/vergil-tooling#3876: the vrg-promote reference links to the rollback runbook.
- vergil-project/vergil-tooling#3877: "Pick the move up on each machine" says a Lima vrg-vm session whose host plugin-dirs.toml lists a vergil plugin tree runs that tree, so a rollback does not reach it; cloud sessions and non-vergil trees are unaffected.
- vergil-project/vergil-tooling#3878 (both halves): "Keeping up to date" points at vrg-host plugins and vrg-vm update --all, and "How long a rollback lasts" says a --no-promote release is promoted later with the runbook's vrg-promote steps and rolling forward is the same steps with the latest v2.1.Z.
Also kept by human ruling: the stale-cache rewrite in git-workflow.md.

Where the docs describe shipped behaviour that differs from the plan text:
- The refresh updates every registered marketplace, not only declared ones, and verifies only the declared ones, so a missing or misspelled entry is not caught; the guide says to confirm the ref by hand.
- vrg-vm update runs tooling, then settings, then plugins; a failed tooling update leaves the old ref. --all skips stopped VMs, a Lima VM's start-time refresh only warns, and an off-platform box does not support vrg-vm start.
- The refresh verification cannot prove a rollback (the ref is v2.1 before and after), so the runbook adds a claude plugin list --json check on every machine.
- The runbook warns that any open plugin release tracking issue re-promotes on vrg-release --resume unless that run passes --no-promote, and covers vrg-promote's uncertain exits and its already-promoted case.

Not fixed: how a stopped off-platform box is brought back, and vrg-vm update's wrong vrg-vm start hint for one, both in vergil-project/.github#799.

Unreviewed commit: 230c346550 (round 5 wording fix: a malformed plugin-dirs.toml still fails a cloud session).

Security: 2 found; 2 fixed on the branch, 0 recorded.

Follow-ups: vergil-project/.github#797 (closes when this merges), vergil-project/vergil-tooling#3879, vergil-project/.github#799.
